item.title: Ready for a jaunt under the Tetons? Park Road clearing underway
item.description: GRAND TETON NATIONAL PARK — Spring has sprung! item.title: Women's History Month: Jenny Lake was named for a young Shoshone woman
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — Jenny Lake, one of Grand Teton National Park’s (GTNP) most iconic features, is named for Jenny Leigh, a young Newe (Shoshone) woman. According to GTNP, Leigh was born in 1849. She married Teton mountain man and trapper Richard ‘Beaver Dick’ Leigh around 14 to 16 years old, and the pair lived in […]

item.title: SNAPPED: Powder hounds make the most of winter, vol. II
item.description: JACKSON, Wyo. — With barely any valley snow to speak of, opportunities for canine snow shenanigans have been different in recent weeks. Still, local dog owners shared their joy-inducing snapshots of their powder hounds enjoying the outdoors this winter.
